commit.message:
pg_query, ocaml-r, ahrocksdb: mark the broken versions as unmaintained

Address https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/pull/31181#issuecomment-6818416686

pg_query, ocaml-r, ahrocksdb: accept CI failures with newer system libraries

These old releases do not build against the C libraries of recent
distributions.

pg_query.0.9.7 fails with glibc >= 2.38, which now declares `strchrnul`
(pganalyze/libpg_query#203). Fixed in 0.9.8
(roddyyaga/pg_query-ocaml#17):

```
src/postgres/src_port_snprintf.c:374:1: error: conflicting types for 'strchrnul'; have 'const char *(const char *, int)'
/usr/include/string.h:286:14: note: previous declaration of 'strchrnul' with type 'char *(const char *, int)'
```

ocaml-r.0.4.0 and 0.5.0 fail with R >= 4.2.0, whose `Rinternals.h` no
longer defines `struct SEXPREC`, even with `USE_RINTERNALS`. 0.6.0 removed
these accessors:

```
read_internal_stub.c:108:32: error: invalid use of undefined type 'struct SEXPREC'
```

ahrocksdb.0.2.0 to 0.2.2 fail with RocksDB >= 6.19, whose `version.h`
includes `<string>` (facebook/rocksdb@0a9a05ae), while
`ffi/lib/config/discover.ml` compiles its probe as C. Fixed upstream in
ahrefs/ocaml-ahrocksdb#5, which is not released in opam:

```
 | /usr/include/rocksdb/version.h:7:10: fatal error: string: No such file or directory
Error: discover error
```

ahrocksdb: ignore CI failures

(version detection is wrong)

ahrocksdb: fix lower bounds

dune-project file requires dune 1.3 and ctypes needs to be 0.13.0 due to
```
#=== ERROR while compiling ahrocksdb.0.2.1 ====================================#
# context              2.2.0~alpha~dev | linux/x86_64 | ocaml-base-compiler.4.08.1 | pinned(https://github.com/ahrefs/ocaml-ahrocksdb/releases/download/0.2.1/ahrocksdb-0.2.1.tbz)
# path                 ~/.opam/4.08/.opam-switch/build/ahrocksdb.0.2.1
# command              ~/.opam/opam-init/hooks/sandbox.sh build dune build -p ahrocksdb -j 71
# exit-code            1
# env-file             ~/.opam/log/ahrocksdb-7-231d82.env
# output-file          ~/.opam/log/ahrocksdb-7-231d82.out
### output ###
#       ocamlc ffi/structs/.rocksdb_types.objs/rocksdb_types.{cmi,cmo,cmt} (exit 2)
# (cd _build/default && /home/opam/.opam/4.08/bin/ocamlc.opt -w -40 -g -bin-annot -I ffi/structs/.rocksdb_types.objs -I ffi/structs/.rocksdb_types.objs/.private -I /home/opam/.opam/4.08/lib/bytes -I /home/opam/.opam/4.08/lib/ctypes -I /home/opam/.opam/4.08/lib/integers -no-alias-deps -o ffi/structs/.rocksdb_types.objs/rocksdb_types.cmo -c -impl ffi/structs/rocksdb_types.ml)
# File "ffi/structs/rocksdb_types.ml", line 1, characters 24-35:
# 1 | module Struct_stubs(S : Ctypes.TYPE) = struct
#                             ^^^^^^^^^^^
# Error: Unbound module type Ctypes.TYPE
```
find packages -name opam -type f -exec sed -i "" -e "s/ *& < *\"v0\.15\"}/}/g" {} \; && git restore -- packages/*/*.v0.14.*/opam
Change all dune subst {pinned} into dune subst {dev}
Relax constraints on JaneStreet packages v0.14

Add a dependency on dune-configurator for all packages that use dune.configurator

Signed-off-by: Jeremie Dimino <jeremie@dimino.org>
ahrocksdb < 0.2.2: Accept CI failures on debian unstable (mssmatch required version of rocksdb)
[1/4] Mark dune as a non-build dependency: sed -Ei 's/(.*)("dune") *\{ *build *\}(.*)/\1\2\3/' **/opam
Remove the upper-bound constraints that were added before adding the JaneStreet bundle v0.12
Add upper bounds to reverse dependencies of Jane Street packages.
